notes: Independence: rows 0-2 of out/038.json were shown while I checked the file's structure, before I translated anything. I left them out of the sample, which is every row from 3 to 46 except 13, 24, 35 and 46. I still read those rows and rows 0-2 of the first translation for meaning errors and found none.

Disagreements (2 of 40, both the same wrong Sorani term): rows 39 (CyberBrick 4WD Car description) and 44 ("Double wishbone independent suspension helps each wheel react cleanly...") wrote "suspension" as «کۆشەن». It is not a Sorani word for vehicle suspension. It occurs nowhere else in out/001-037 or in src/, so a reader gets no meaning from it. Batch 035 uses «سووسپێنشن» («سیستەمی سووسپێنشنی ئۆتۆمبێلی RC»). Fixed to «سووسپێنشنی سەربەخۆی دوو باڵ (double wishbone)» in both rows. Only the ckb field of those two rows changed: the two «کۆشەنی» became «سووسپێنشنی» and every other byte of the file is unchanged (same indent=1 serialization). Backup: rev038/038.before.json.

The "non-3D printed parts" template (rows 0, 11, 13, 15): the validator protects the token "non-3D", so the glossary form «القطع غير المطبوعة بطابعة 3D» / «ئەو پارچانەی بە 3D چاپ ناکرێن» would fail TOKEN_LOST and would also break the digit count. The first translation's «القطع غير المطبوعة (non-3D)» / «ئەو پارچانەی ... کە چاپ ناکرێن (non-3D)» keeps the meaning and matches batches 012 and 013. My «(non-3D printed)» is a style variant. "3D-printed" (row 10) and "3D-printable" (row 30) are also protected, and both versions carry them in brackets, as batches 032, 035 and 037 do.

Names: every product name is copied verbatim (Magic Night Cat Pumpkin Lantern, The Modular Lantern, The Alchemist's Study – A Magical Diorama, AMS Drawer for X/P-Series with Printed Slides, CyberBrick RC Wheel Loader, CyberBrick RC Ghost, CyberBrick RC Pumpkin, Kliko Truck Platform, CyberBrick 4WD Car, 4x4 Mini Off-Roader), as are MakerWorld, CyberBrick, RC, LED, PETG, 4WD, 1:25, 1:20, 6x4 and 4x2. The first translation puts a head noun before some names («فانوس» / «فانۆسی», «درج» / «چەکمەجەی», «مجسّم» / «دیۆرامای», «جرّافة» / «لۆدەری», «سيارة» / «ئۆتۆمبێلی»). This follows the glossary's head-noun pattern and translates no name. The English "Cyberbrick" (row 39) is written as the brand CyberBrick in both versions.

All other differences are style only. Examples: «كبير الحضور» vs «كبير الشخصية» for "big on character" (row 10); «سیحر» vs «جادوو» for "magic" (rows 4, 5); «طبعة 3D» (the glossary noun) vs «مطبوعة 3D» (rows 17, 39); «تغذية راجعة عملية» vs «إشارات عملية» for "practical feedback" (row 34); «گازدان» vs «کۆنترۆڵی خێرایی» for "throttle" (row 38); «پێداویستی» vs «پاشکۆ» for "accessories" (row 32). «پێداویستی» is the app's word (src AccessoryPicker, translations.ts) and is used 96 times in earlier batches. «سووکانی جومگەدار» for "articulated steering" (row 10) is correct Sorani.

Facts kept in both languages in all 47 rows: "you also need to download the model files and 3D print the remaining parts" (rows 0, 11, 13, 15), "install the compatible CyberBrick hardware" (17), "with the included remote control" and "choose to" (5), "30min" / "4h to assemble" (18, 40), "1:25 scale" (8), "1:20 scale", "6x4 or 4x2" (30), "than the earlier 4x4 Mini Off-Roader platform" (42) and "recommended transparent PETG lighting profile" (46). The English typo "ompact" (row 10) is read as "Compact" in both. "every October" is «كل تشرين الأول (أكتوبر)» / «هەموو تشرینی یەکەمێک», which is Iraqi usage.

Owner report «التوافق مكرر» (compatibility repeated): batch 38 has one compatibility sentence, row 38 ("CyberBrick remote compatibility keeps steering, throttle, and functions in one familiar control setup"). It states compatibility once in ar and ckb. No row repeats a sentence inside itself; rows 28 and 33 are different titles from two products.

Validator: packages/catalog/src/bambuImport/i18n.ts validateTranslationRow (levonis-i18n worktree) with names.json and IDENTITY, run through rev018/val.mts. All 47 rows of out/038.json pass before and after the fix, and so do my 40 independent rows. The file has no keep and no needs_review rows.

Script scan of the whole file: no ckb has an Arabic-only letter (ة ى ي ك) or the Arabic article ال; no ar has a Sorani letter; no ckb copies the ar; there are no bidi control characters and no line breaks; there are no price, stock, shipping or delivery words; no translation begins with a Latin run, so dir="auto" resolves every row to RTL.
